fragments.text: Cao-Rhinehart R-statistic: R = V_filtered / V_unfiltered. At steady state R→1.0. Pure state-based, zero time dependence. Lambda=0.05-0.2, R_critical=0.5-0.8.
fragments.applicability: low — degenerates on binary hash data

fragments.text: Tag-Trigger-Consolidation (TagTriC): individual tag threshold + population trigger threshold. Neuromodulatory state (dopamine) lowers trigger threshold for behaviorally significant events.
B-cell IRF4 graded accumulator: signal quality integral, not repetition count. Positive autoregulation accelerates stability. Bistable switch with hysteresis — once flipped, irreversible.
Physarum dD/dt = f(|Q|) - D: current flow magnitude drives reinforcement, decay term continuously challenges. Threshold sensing yields optimal paths. Zero historical dependence.
Classical Nucleation Theory: clusters below critical radius dissolve naturally. Only super-critical clusters grow irreversibly. Sub-critical = safe fluctuation, not premature commitment.
fragments.applicability: conceptual — confidence < 0.8 = sub-critical, dissolves on any change

fragments.text: Omori aftershock decay n(t) = K/(c+t)^p: quiet-after-change has different meaning depending on elapsed time. Z-value > 2.0 distinguishes genuine quiescence from normal decay.
fragments.applicability: low — requires continuous time series, not applicable to discrete turns

fragments.text: Jazz critical slowing down: rising lag-1 autocorrelation + rising variance = approaching critical transition. Same early warning signals as ecosystem tipping points (Scheffer 2009).
fragments.applicability: low — signal processing overhead, insufficient data points per session

fragments.text: NashConv: deviation incentive per actor → 0 = equilibrium. Asks 'would anyone benefit from changing?' not 'has it been unchanged for N turns?'
fragments.applicability: conceptual — framing for why counter-based is wrong

fragments.text: Raft leader stability: term + heartbeat + quorum. Three interlocking signals, any one failing triggers step-down. Quorum intersection prevents false positive in partitioned networks.
Combat sports pattern detection: stability = collapse of degrees of freedom. Weight transfer = committed, posture optionality = still probing. Binary detection, not accumulated count.
fragments.applicability: conceptual — agent in execute phase = 'committed posture'

fragments.text: sensorium.stability measures doom-loop severity (none=1.0, warn=0.6, blocked=0.2), NOT field stability. Using it to modulate promotion would INVERT behavior during doom loops.
Sensorium simplified from 6D to 3D (momentum, pressure, confidence) in commit f191be1. stability, complexity, freshness dimensions deleted.
PromptEngine has zero references to sensorium. Architectural boundary: src/prompt/ has zero imports from src/agent/. But setBehaviorMirror/setStrategyShift setter pattern already exists.
R-statistic on binary data (hash match/no-match) degenerates to match_count/window_size — essentially what the fixed counter already does.
